summary: The root WFY primarily means to fulfill, complete, or perform something fully and perfectly.

provenance.lane: Edward William Lane, An Arabic-English Lexicon (1863-93), public domain. Digital text via Perseus, Tufts University, CC BY-SA 3.0 US.
provenance.summary: Editorial summary derived from the Lane entry. NOT Lane's own wording. Shown as a gloss only; the Lane text below is the source.

headwords.def: وَفَى بِالعَهْدِ and بِالوَعْدِ [ He fulfilled, performed, kept, or was faithful to, the compact, or covenant, and the promise ]: act. part. n. وَفِىٌّ; pl. أَوْفِيَآءُ. (Msb.) وَفَآءٌ signifies The being faithful to an engagement, or promise: see 1, last sentence, in art. رعى. وَفَاهُ He paid it: see an ex. ( فِى ثَوْبَىْ أَبِى أَنْ أَفِيَهُ ) voce ثَوْبٌ.
وَفَّاهُ حَقَّهُ and and and and He paid, or rendered, to him fully, or completely, his right, or due. (K. [In the CK, اَوْفاهُ is erroneously put for وَافَاهُ.])
وَافَى بِهِ He brought it: see a verse cited in art. سجد. See 2.

أَوْفَى عَلَيْهِ He looked upon it, looked upon it from above, looked down upon it; got a view of it; or saw it; syn. أَشْرَفَ عَلَيْهِ, (S, Msb, K, TA,) and اِطَّلَعَ; and اوفى فِيهِ [likewise] signifies اشرف. (TA.) See 2.
تَوَفَّاهُ ٱللّٰهُ God took his soul, (S, K,) [either at death, or in sleep. See the Kur-án, vi. 60]: or caused him to die. (Msb.) See 2 and 10.
and He [ exacted, ] took, or received, it fully, or wholly. (Mgh.) See an ex. voce عَلَى. See 2. اِسْتَوْفَى [ He completed ] so many years of his age. (A, O, in TA, voce احفر.)
: see وَفَى. وَفِىُّ العَهْدِ [ A fulfiller, performer, or keeper, of the compact, or covenant. (TA, voce إِلٌّ.)

headword_note: Lane organises by verb form and principal noun, not by every inflected form. A word with no headword entry falls back to the root meaning; nothing is inferred.
